title: Invoice export supports CSV format
description: Extend the invoice export capability to include a CSV format option in addition to the existing PDF export. The CSV should include all fields visible in the invoice list view. The export should honour any active filters.
acceptance_criteria: See bead clc-abc.1 for the acceptance criteria. The implementation must satisfy all criteria documented in that bead.

metadata.intent: Give users a machine-readable export format suitable for import into spreadsheet applications.
